card.description: A towering 12‑meter obelisk carved from obsidian basalt, etched with luminous hieroglyphic glyphs that pulse with bio‑luminescent energy and integrated with crystalline circuitry humming a low‑frequency resonance. Anchored to a stone base with intricate metal filigree reminiscent of ancient Ethiopian stelae, the structure emits a soft, otherworldly glow that reflects off wet stone and illuminates swirling dust motes, embodying a fusion of ancient mysticism and incomprehensible technology.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** 12‑meter tapered obelisk, obsidian basalt core, metal filigree base with stone anchoring.
**Face/Sensors:** Glyph panels with bio‑luminescent veins, crystalline sensor nodes embedded in the surface.
**Key Features:** Pulsing glyphs, crystalline circuitry, low‑frequency hum, dust motes, wet stone reflection.
evolution: Phase 1 (Inception): Obelisk erected, glyphs etched, crystalline hardware installed.
Phase 2 (Activation): Glyphs pulse, bio‑luminescence intensifies, resonance hum begins.
props: Item: Ancient Scroll of Resonance – tattered parchment etched with matching glyphs.
Item: Crystal Lens – transparent crystal embedded in the base, amplifying the bio‑luminescent glow.
